product_commit: freeze actual tested commit before execution
corpus: synthetic diagnostic, public, not natural real-world tasks

arms.direct: typed/source investigation then one final answer; no explicit recheck instruction
arms.generic: same typed/source tools; provisional answer then generic verification instruction
arms.exception_checklist: same typed/source tools; provisional answer then targeted exception-path verification

metric: F4 proposition coverage, final quality, critical errors, total and marginal host usage and separate ledger settlement
limitations: No claim that past forced verification caused improvement
Independent initial answers differ; paired PRECHECK deltas are descriptive, not shared-state causal estimates
Synthetic tasks expose known failure modes; do not present as unseen natural tasks
Do not reuse legacy approvals or mutate prior kits
stop: Any contract mismatch, unknown delivery, unknown usage, unapproved spend or failed receipt stops batch; no automatic retries
base_guide: Identical neutral typed/source guide across arms, no final-check/checklist instructions anywhere in model-visible stack. Do not inject routing-v5 checklist. If unavoidable, direct is no-extra-turn, not no-recheck.
